angle: The CRM writes its own ads: the Studio drafts the caption, the Google lines and the artwork from the project already sitting in inventory, badges every result with the model that made it, and shows the reason when a draft is thrown out.

hook.question: Why is your CRM not writing it?

scenes.vo: Your price, your locality, your unit types already sit inside the CRM.
Nothing fires on page load. One press writes the caption and headlines.

chip.title: Nothing on page load

scenes.vo: Rejected drafts show the reason. Good ones are badged with the model.
Campaigns are records. Nothing is sent, so you post it.
Pick the Reel size, generate the background, then do the next project.
